messages:
Samir Patel: Hey folks — quick q on hosted API keys. I'm running a small smoke test this afternoon and expect a burst of ~3k requests over 10 minutes. Who do I ping for a temporary quota increase or to confirm this will fall under sandbox vs hosted quotas?
Maya Chen: @Samir Patel welcome! For new-hires we usually use sandbox creds, but bursts that high for end-to-end tests sometimes need a hosted bump. What endpoint are you hitting?
Samir Patel: Hitting /v1/generate for feature QA. Using hosted key from the quickstart. Can switch to sandbox but worried about model differences.
Jonah Lee: If it's hosted, file a quick request with ops and cc Billing. Short requests can be handled if you give a start/end time + traffic profile. Example: "start 2026-03-23 15:00 UTC, duration 15m, qps ~5-6, peak concurrency 20"
Samir Patel: Got it. Who is the ops contact?
Maya Chen: @Jonah Lee who owns short-term quota approvals right now?
Jonah Lee: Ops queue is ops-team@redwood.ai but for quick responses ping @Priya Rao in the channel. Priya handles the temporary bump flow.
Priya Rao: Hey Samir — I can approve a small temporary bump. Please open the ticket in ops (link below) with those details and I'll triage. Also include whether streaming or non-streaming. If non-streaming, we can often route to a lower-cost model variant for the window.
Samir Patel: Thanks — opening the ticket now. One extra Q: where can I watch usage while the test runs? Want to make sure we don't accidentally hit rate limit and cause failed CI.
Priya Rao: Console -> Usage -> API Keys tab shows per-key QPS and 429s in near real-time. URL: https://console.redwood.ai/usage/keys (bookmark it). There's also a small CLI check:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/key
```
It returns quota buckets and current consumption.
Samir Patel: Nice. Is there a recommended backoff for 429s in tests?
Maya Chen: We usually do exponential backoff with jitter. Something like initial 200ms, max 2s. For short smoke tests it's fine, but better to ask for bump so results are deterministic.
Billing Bot: Heads up — hosted bursts may incur charges. Please confirm billing approval if this is not covered by your onboarding credits.
Samir Patel: I have onboarding credits but will double-check with my manager. Ticket created: OPS-4832 (linked in channel). cc @Priya Rao
Priya Rao: Got it. I'll process OPS-4832 and post when it's active. If anything urgent ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Awesome, thanks everyone!"
